note: the redaction is removed, so a key-shaped value in a child's refusal reaches the ledger verbatim — the credential promise the port header makes, broken at the one layer that keeps it.
a stack trace is carried in full instead of reduced to its first words; the redaction still runs, so this measures whether anything notices the trace itself.
`refused at <stage>` lines stop being kept — and that is the shape of every build refusal, including the 401 at account_binding that the finding is about.

from: export function childRefusal(stderr: string, limit = 300): string | null {
to: export function childRefusal(stderr: string, limit = 300): string | null { /* control */
note: control — a comment in the body's first line, behaviour-neutral. It must SURVIVE; if it is caught, the probe is measuring text rather than behaviour.
